{{Youmay|the journal kept by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kazan]]|the real-life [[Starlog (magazine)|magazine]]}}
A '''starlog''' was a type of electronic journal kept by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kazan]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[RS Revenge]]''. A series of starlog entries he made during [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[mission to Panna Prime]] were used as narration in a [[Unidentified Rebel cartoon|cartoon]] that was later made about the mission.
